column1: # fnv-nx native renderer (S6n): native replacements of decomp functions, consumed by
#   tools/link/fnvlink.py resolve --override render/native/overrides.tsv   (feature request R1 in REQUESTS.md)
# Columns (tab-separated): address <TAB> our symbol <TAB> ABI / notes
#   address: hex function address, or vslot:<MSVC vftable symbol>:<slot index> for a virtual whose implementation
#            address the image vftable holds (R1b: the linker reads the slot and treats the row as that address).
# Rows marked "N1-pending" are planned (docs: render/native/N1_PLAN.md) and skipped by the linker. "vft=<class>:<slot>"
# in the notes names the image vftable slot that holds the address (read from the user's exe by
# tools/exe_vftables.py into the gitignored vftables.tsv; tests/s6n/test_overrides.py checks it when that exists). Every other row's
# symbol is defined in libnxrender.a (render/native/n1/build.sh; n1/engine_stubs.cpp), checked by
# Link (native build only, after NATIVE1 drops render/native/drop_units.txt):
# ---- NiDX9Renderer (NiRenderer protected virtuals; slots from the image vftable, REQUESTS.md R2) ----
